name: The Secret Ingredient Is...
source:
On his unyielding quest for employment, the protagonist picks up an odd job request at the townsboard from the local alchemist.

[From [url=https://velkami.itch.io/the-secret-ingredient-is]Itch.io[/url]]

A fan-game based on the video game "The Elder Scrolls V: Skirym".
translation:
主人公始终不懈地寻找工作，这次，他在镇上的公告栏接下了当地炼金术师发布的一份零工委托。

[摘自[url=https://velkami.itch.io/the-secret-ingredient-is]Itch.io[/url]]

本作是基于电子游戏《上古卷轴5：天际》创作的同人游戏。
